Manage lists and data in Google Sheets

Add new options on a new row. They appear automatically or when you click “Refresh lists”.

  • AoS Tables: unique ID in column A, name in B, Active in C. Blank Active cells count as enabled.
  • AoS Armies / AoS Battleplans: name in A, alliance or group in B, Active in C.
  • AoS Battletactics: name in A, Active in B.
  • Game · ID: both players side by side. Edit scores, armies, battletactics and objectives (0 or 5) directly. Edit other VP; total VP includes objectives automatically.

Uncheck Active to hide an option. Game settings are managed in the app.
